# Plan: plan-carry-forward

Goal: Close the hole SPEC left in its own rule: §Forward compatibility of plan_updated says an unrecognised status is coerced to pending AND WARNED ABOUT, while an OMITTED status reached the same destination in silence. RULED 2026-08-13 as (e), D1: extend the fold's existing coerce-and-warn to omission, scoped to entries PRESENT in the payload whose previous status was resolved. Diagnostic, never preventive — state is untouched, so every historical log folds byte-identically, and because 1.1 measured the omission shape at ZERO the change is provably silent on all existing history. Renames are ruled out with reasons (D2); the 34 recent phase closes need nothing (D3). Phase 4 then fixed what D1's own phase review found: doctor showed only the FIRST fold warning per record, so the new signal would have been a bare count in exactly the records that already had warnings (D4). Measured, not assumed — the original premise that this bug had fired did NOT survive Phase 1, and the record carries both retractions by name.
